## What the executor needs

| Backend action | Requirement | Configured tool | Advertised? | Candidates on this server |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `connect_pins` | Join two named component pins onto one net | `kicad_connect_pins` | yes | `kicad_connect_pin_to_net`, `kicad_connect_pins` |
| `connect_pin_to_net` | Join one component pin to an existing named net | `kicad_connect_pin_to_net` | yes | `kicad_connect_pin_to_net`, `kicad_connect_pins` |
| `add_component` | Place a symbol and connect both of its terminals | `kicad_add_component` | yes | `kicad_add_component` |
| `read_schematic` | Read back components, pins and nets | `kicad_read_schematic` | yes | `kicad_read_schematic` |

## Tools the server advertises

### `kicad_connect_pins`

Join two component pins onto one net by placing a global label on each pin's connection point. Pins are 'REF.PIN', e.g. 'U2.SDA' or 'U1.21'.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `project` | string | yes | Absolute path to the KiCAD project directory |
| `from_pin` | string | yes | First pin, as REF.PIN |
| `to_pin` | string | yes | Second pin, as REF.PIN |
| `net` | string | yes | Net name to place on both pins |

### `kicad_connect_pin_to_net`

Join one component pin to an existing named net, e.g. '+3V3' or 'GND'.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `project` | string | yes | Absolute path to the KiCAD project directory |
| `pin` | string | yes | Pin to connect, as REF.PIN |
| `net` | string | yes | Net to join |

### `kicad_add_component`

Place a two-terminal symbol and connect its terminals to the two named nets. Skips placement when a matching part already bridges those nets.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `project` | string | yes | Absolute path to the KiCAD project directory |
| `symbol` | string | yes | Library id, e.g. 'Device:R' |
| `value` | string | yes | Component value, e.g. '4.7k' |
| `connect` | array | yes | The two nets to bridge, [signal, rail] |

### `kicad_read_schematic`

Read back components, their pins and the nets each pin sits on.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `project` | string | yes | Absolute path to the KiCAD project directory |

## Still to confirm by hand

1. Whether each mapped tool writes to disk immediately (ERC runs on the saved file).
2. Whether adding a symbol and connecting it is one call or place-then-connect.
3. Whether a Mitos-side undo exists, or the file-level checkpoint stays the rollback.
4. Whether the current KiCAD selection is readable, which would enable §5.2 live selection.
5. Whether PCB edits are supported, which is what makes the DRC gate meaningful.
